goal: Run one bounded English Web module phase and one feature-oracle item until evidence proves pass, block, or fail.
done_when: phase report exists with Status line
browser or runtime evidence is recorded
feature oracle status and evidence are updated
independent critic artifact exists with Critic Verdict
continue_when: active phase still has failing acceptance gates
required commands can run locally or a blocker path is recorded
stop_when: production credentials or secret values are required
Supabase migration or provider dashboard mutation is required without approval
edits outside the phase boundary are required
destructive command is requested without explicit approval
